NPT-4014                                                                                                                   about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 20-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination -Nov/ Dec -2024  
  ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE [NPT-4014]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare the Turing Test with the Winograd Schema Challenge as methods of  
  evaluating machine intelligence. What are the strengths and weaknesses of each?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the effectiveness of depth-first search versus breadth-first search in a specific  
  problem context.                                                                             (5)  
  
  2)           Evaluate Hill Climbing as a heuristic search strategy. How does it perform in terms of  
  efficiency and susceptibility to local optima?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the effectiveness of Genetic Algorithms in solving optimization problems,  
  focusing on how selection, crossover, and mutation contribute to solution diversity.         (5)  
  
  3)           Evaluate the importance of heuristic admissibility in A* search and discuss how it  
  impacts pathfinding optimality.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare Weighted A* and IDA* algorithms, focusing on their differences in memory  
  usage and accuracy of solutions.                                                             (5)  
  
  4)           Analyze the SSS* (Starred Minimax) algorithm's significance in game playing. Evaluate  
  how it compares to traditional Minimax in terms of computational efficiency.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the advantages and limitations of Goal Stack Planning in problem-solving. In  
  what types of problems does this technique work best?                                        (5)  
  
  5)           Evaluate the AO* algorithm's suitability for solving AND-OR graphs. How effective is  
  it in real-world applications that require problem decomposition?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the function of a Rete Net in rule-based expert systems and discuss how it  
  optimizes rule matching in large systems.                                                    (5)
